'''Annabelle DaVoren''' is a farmwife from [[Aturo's Orchard]].
== History ==
Annabelle is married to [[Fenton DaVoren]]. They have two children, [[Tobias DaVoren|Tobias]] and [[Issa DaVoren|Issa]].

The town is attacked by [[Whitecloaks]], and the farm is left in ruin.<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
